description: Bellast is a monophasic, non-animal cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler range from Korean manufacturer Dongkook Pharmaceutical, produced by a double-polymerisation process. The Ultra line spans multiple gel firmnesses (Soft L, L and Plus), letting a clinic address superficial lines through to deeper volumising from one brand. Lidocaine-containing 'L' variants are formulated for injection comfort.
howItWorks: On implantation the cross-linked HA gel restores volume and binds tissue water, with the correction plane and indication governed by each variant's gel firmness (G-prime) and particle characteristics: softer grades for fine/superficial work and firmer grades for deep structural support and contour.
composition: Non-animal, bacterial-fermentation cross-linked hyaluronic acid at approximately 20 mg/mL in a monophasic gel; lidocaine-containing variants add roughly 0.3% lidocaine. Firmness increases from Soft L to L to Plus.
usageNotes: Store per the manufacturer label and use within the stated shelf life; select injection plane by variant (superficial for softer grades, deeper/subdermal for firmer grades); keep hyaluronidase on hand for vascular occlusion or correction. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.
features: Monophasic non-animal HA produced by double-polymerisation
Firmness tiers: Soft L / L / Plus
Single-brand range covering multiple treatment depths
benefits: One portfolio spans fine-line to deep-volume indications, simplifying stock
Built-in lidocaine reduces need for separate anaesthetic and chair time
Cost-competitive Korean HA option to protect margin
Monophasic gel supports smooth, even extrusion

description: Renefill (marketed as Renefil) is a Korean hybrid dermal filler from BMI Korea that combines cross-linked hyaluronic acid with polynucleotides (PN) and lidocaine. It is positioned as a volumising filler with an added tissue-conditioning component and is offered in Light Plus, Deep Plus and Ultra Plus grades. Note: unlike a pure HA gel, Renefill contains a polynucleotide fraction marketed for skin regeneration alongside HA volumisation.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel provides immediate volume and binds water while the polynucleotide fraction is marketed to support tissue conditioning; correction depth follows particle size and gel firmness across the Light (fine, ~250 microns) to Ultra (deep, ~1,000 microns) grades.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid approximately 20 mg/mL combined with polynucleotides approximately 1.875 mg/mL, plus lidocaine for comfort; supplied in graded particle sizes (Light Plus finest, Ultra Plus largest).
usageNotes: Store per label; match grade to plane (Light for superficial/fine work, Deep and Ultra for mid-to-deep placement); keep hyaluronidase available for the HA component. Confirm current market registration before ordering.
features: Three grades: Light Plus / Deep Plus / Ultra Plus
benefits: Combines volumising and tissue-conditioning positioning in one product for a differentiated menu
Lidocaine reduces separate anaesthetic requirement
Grade range covers superficial lines through deep contour
Premium hybrid offering supports higher price points

description: Elasty Plus is a monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler line from Korean manufacturer Dongbang Medical, made with the company's PNET (Preserved Natural Entanglement Technology) cross-linking. The Plus range contains lidocaine and comes in three firmness grades: G (volume), D (deep) and F (fine). This 1CC presentation is supplied as a single-syringe volume at 24 mg/mL HA.
howItWorks: The cross-linked, monophasic HA gel adds volume and binds water; firmness (G-prime) and particle handling set the plane, with G delivering deep structural support and contour, D targeting deep wrinkles and folds, and F intended for finer, more superficial correction.
composition: Monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL with lidocaine (about 3 mg/mL in G Plus); manufactured with PNET cross-linking marketed for near-zero residual BDDE. 1CC single-syringe presentation.
usageNotes: Store per label; place G in the deep/subcutaneous plane, D in deep dermis and F in mid/superficial dermis; keep hyaluronidase available for correction. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.
features: PNET cross-linking with low residual BDDE
Grades G / D / F for depth selection
benefits: Higher 24 mg/mL concentration marketed for firmness and longevity
Lidocaine reduces separate anaesthetic and chair time
Grade system lets one brand cover multiple indications
Smaller 1CC unit suits lower-volume or trial procedures

The 2CC format suits higher-volume treatments such as full-face contouring.

composition: Monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL with lidocaine (about 3 mg/mL in G Plus); PNET cross-linking marketed for near-zero residual BDDE. 2CC (2 x 1 mL) presentation.
usageNotes: Store per label; place G in the deep/subcutaneous plane, D in deep dermis and F in mid/superficial dermis; keep hyaluronidase available for correction. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.

Grades G / D / F for depth selection
benefits: Larger 2CC pack improves cost-per-mL for high-volume cases

description: HyalDew is a monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler range from Korean manufacturer BioPlus, produced with the company's MCL (Multi-staged Cross-Linking, part of its MDM technology) microbead process. The line is graded by gel and particle size: All (subdermal volume), Mid (dermal restructuring), Fine (superficial correction) and Shine (skin-booster/hydration), at 20 mg/mL HA with or without lidocaine. Note: the verified manufacturer is BioPlus, not Huons.
howItWorks: The monophasic cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water; the microbead particle size and gel firmness (G-prime) set the plane, from firmer subdermal grades (All) for volume to finer grades (Fine/Shine) for superficial hydration and line softening.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL in a monophasic microbead gel (MCL/MDM technology); lidocaine-containing versions add about 0.3% lidocaine. Non-lidocaine versions are also available.
usageNotes: Store per label; match grade to depth (All deepest, Shine most superficial); keep hyaluronidase available for correction; choose lidocaine or non-lidocaine per patient. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.
features: Four grades: All / Mid / Fine / Shine
benefits: Four-grade range covers volumising to skin-booster use from one brand
Lidocaine option reduces separate anaesthetic and chair time
Skin-booster (Shine) tier extends the treatment menu
Cost-competitive Korean HA option to protect margin

description: Regenovue Plus is a monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler range from Korean manufacturer CHA Meditech, marketed for a high HA cross-linking factor and low residual BDDE. The Plus line contains 0.3% lidocaine and is offered in three grades: Sub-Q Plus (deep volume and contour), Deep Plus (deep wrinkles and folds) and Fine Plus (superficial lines), with Sub-Q Plus reported at 24 mg/mL HA.
howItWorks: The monophasic cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water; gel firmness (G-prime) and particle size set the plane, with the firmest Sub-Q grade for deep structural volume, Deep for folds, and Fine for superficial line correction.
composition: Cross-linked sodium hyaluronate in a monophasic gel (Sub-Q Plus reported at approximately 24 mg/mL), with 0.3% lidocaine across the Plus line.
usageNotes: Store per label; place Sub-Q in the deep subcutaneous plane, Deep in deep dermis and Fine in mid/superficial dermis; keep hyaluronidase available for correction. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.
features: Marketed high cross-linking factor with low residual BDDE
Three grades: Sub-Q Plus / Deep Plus / Fine Plus
benefits: Grade range covers superficial lines to deep contour from one brand

description: Medam (marketed as Hyafilia ME:DAM) is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler range from Korean manufacturer CHA Meditech, built on a gel structure combining stabilised and native HA (marketed as roughly 85% stabilised and 15% native) to blend monophasic and biphasic characteristics. HA concentration is 20 mg/mL and the line is graded as Light (mild, fine work), Prime (medium density) and Deep (high density, deep folds and contour). Lidocaine-containing 'Plus' presentations are also offered.
howItWorks: The cross-linked HA gel adds volume and binds water; the blend of stabilised and native HA plus gel firmness (G-prime) and particle size set the plane, with Light for superficial/fine correction, Prime for medium-depth work, and Deep for deep folds and structural contour.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL in a hybrid gel (approximately 85% stabilised / 15% native) with combined mono/biphasic characteristics; lidocaine available in Plus versions.
usageNotes: Store per label; match grade to depth (Light superficial, Prime mid, Deep deep/subdermal); keep hyaluronidase available for correction; choose lidocaine (Plus) or non-lidocaine per patient. Verify current CE/KFDA registration for your market before ordering.
benefits: Hybrid gel positioning blends cohesivity with lift
Grade range covers fine lines to deep contour from one brand
Lidocaine Plus options reduce separate anaesthetic and chair time
Competitive Korean HA line from an established maker (CHA Meditech)
indications: Fine lines and light lip volume (Light)
